function.name: skills.List
function.description: List all Agent Skills available in this sandbox with their status, description, tools and scripts.

function.name: skills.Load
function.description: Load an available Agent Skill by name so its scripts become executable.

name.description: The skill name, exactly as listed by skills.List.

function.name: skills.Unload
function.description: Unload a previously loaded Agent Skill by name.

name.description: The loaded skill name, exactly as listed by skills.List.

function.name: skills.Execute
function.description: Execute a script of a loaded Agent Skill with arguments and return its output.

name.description: The loaded skill name, exactly as listed by skills.List.

script.description: The script file name of the skill, e.g. "scan.py". Must be one of the scripts listed by skills.List for that skill.

arguments.description: Optional array of string arguments passed to the script, e.g. ["https://example.com"]. Omit it or use [] when no arguments are needed.
